def min_period(constraints, upper):
    for p in range(1,upper+1):
        vals={}; ok=True
        for i,v in constraints.items():
            if i%p in vals and vals[i%p]!=v: ok=False; break
            vals[i%p]=v
        if ok:return p,vals
# Demonstration 1 constraints and diagonal demo motif constraints
print('demo1',min_period({1:2,2:1,4:8,6:9,7:9,10:4,12:5},13))
